heading: Block the capability, not the function: how a popup got past ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode
intro: Check Point found that ChatGPT's HTML previews guarded popups by wrapping one function while the sandbox still granted the capability. Here are the sources, plus two coding-agent flaws where a check covered the usual path but not a second one.
items: Check Point Research: ChatGPT Lockdown Mode Bypass
Alexey Bukhteyev: a nested iframe reached an unwrapped window.open, and popups escaped the preview sandbox and Lockdown Mode; zero clicks in ChatGPT Classic. OpenAI fixed it by Sept 18, 2026.
What the setting turns off (live browsing, internet images, Canvas networking, connectors, downloads) to limit prompt-injection exfiltration.
Saltzer and Schroeder: The Protection of Information in Computer Systems
The 1975 source of complete mediation: every access to every object must be checked for authority.
Four coding agents checked out a pinned plugin commit but never verified where they landed; the fix compares git rev-parse HEAD with the pin.
Background git calls ran a repository's own core.fsmonitor command outside the sandbox, with no approval prompt.
An open-source sandbox (preview, macOS on Apple silicon) that sends shell, Python, MCP, and network actions through one default-deny policy engine outside the agent.
